picks.detail: WeAreBrain’s Truck Tyre Assist case describes supplier notifications, acceptance handling and status updates in an ERP workflow. In a trial, ask two suppliers to respond to one case. Check that a dispatcher can see who accepted it and what happens to the second response.

Slalom’s Genie case identifies the client, the support function and a rollout involving 180 agents. Ask the delivery lead which parts of a comparable bid cover training, queue configuration and post-launch support. Price those separately so a cheaper prototype is easy to spot alongside a fully staffed rollout.

The ZF case documents Capgemini’s work on a global automation service. For a buyer with several candidate workflows, the first deliverable could be a prioritized backlog. Ask each process owner to identify the exception that consumes the most time, then check whether the proposed pilot includes it.

methodology: Compare agency proposals on one unit of work, such as a dispatched case or an approved order. Count failed attempts, manual review and maintenance when testing the agency’s saving estimate.
commercial_relationship: The publisher sells AI implementation services.
questions: Bring five anonymized examples, including a duplicate and an incomplete request.
Ask to see the audit trail for one completed run and one failed run.
Before handover, have your operator replay a failed job and confirm that it creates only one downstream record.
pricing: Compare the setup fee, support retainer and per-run costs at your normal and peak volumes. Ask whether connector changes and failed-job investigation are included.

firms.name: WeAreBrain
firms.note: Offers workflow automation and integration. Test two suppliers replying to one dispatch request. Count how many assignments and customer notifications the workflow creates.

firms.name: Goodspeed
firms.note: Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. If the quote includes training, ask staff to modify a live-style staging workflow and price their time in the savings calculation.

firms.name: LowCode Agency
firms.note: Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. Request the cost of adding one approval rule after launch. Include platform usage and any minimum support commitment.

firms.name: Capgemini
firms.note: Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask for the cost of monitoring a backlog across two departments when only one of them supplies clean inputs.

firms.name: IBM Consulting
firms.note: Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Simulate a downstream outage in the trial and ask who pays for repeated integration calls while the dependency is unavailable.

firms.name: Slalom
firms.note: Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Request the volume and staffing assumptions behind a contact-routing automation. Count escalations that return to a human queue.

firms.name: Deloitte
firms.note: Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Have the agency include data cleanup in the estimate when comparing manual and automated processing time.

firms.name: Accenture
firms.note: Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Compare the scope of the initial deployment with ongoing paid support. Ask for one example of a change billed separately.

firms.name: BCG
firms.note: Combines strategy and applied AI. For a multi-team rollout, calculate the monthly benefit for one workflow before adding the expected savings from other units.

firms.name: McKinsey QuantumBlack
firms.note: Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Which past project matches our scope, and who owned delivery and handover?
